rulings.why: Verified: rituals reach the sheet only through Overrides -> Add spell (SpellsTab.tsx:604) and no feat field grants a known ritual; sanctification exists only as an effectChoices options pick (qi-zhong), which is illegal with one fixed value. needsEngineWork stands.
Upheld: a timed self-state on YOUR fists is what the mode lane carries; 104 of the 146 records in toggle-modes.json are note-only, so the shape is precedented.

Upheld and VERIFIED against the source: the AoN mirror (rules-1695, Book of the Dead p.44) gives Advanced Undead Benefits as darkvision, poison resistance half level, +2 vs disease/poison and +1 vs paralysis/sleep - the judge quoted it exactly, and core.json ships the rules record as a bare stub with no text.
Same verified Advanced Undead Benefits grant as ghostly-grasp; both ids exist as separate takeable records in core.feats, so both need the fields.
Upheld: the reach field exists (jotuns-heart, bound-in-ice) but is UNCONDITIONAL, so using it would give 10-ft reach outside rage - the judge correctly refused the over-grant and used the mode lane.
Upheld: sizeOverride and reach both exist but are unconditional; the grant lasts only while raging, so the mode lane is the only non-over-granting expression.
Upheld: I read SpellSlotBonus (types.ts:376-393) - perRank, exceptHighest, byRank, entryId. There is no highest-rank-only form and no content restriction, so any field write would over-grant.
Upheld: CompanionMod (companionGrants.ts:118-147) has no size field; stealthy-companion is the shipped note-only precedent.

Upheld: critSpecWeapons.bases is a declared key (types.ts:320, weaponMatches derive.ts:1243) and I confirmed all five ids in core.items - flail, khopesh, mambele, spear, war-flail. The text names no open-ended sixth clause, so the fix is exact.

Upheld, reason corrected: grantsLanguages DOES exist for feats (build.ts:3220) - what is missing is a CHOICE lane. settlement-scholastics carries choice.from.type language and is flagged inert ('a feat-granted language is not added to your Languages yet'), so the wiring genuinely is absent. needsEngineWork stands.

Upheld but the fix was incomplete: unarmedTraits (types.ts:785, applyUnarmedRiders derive.ts:1692) carries 'your unarmed Strikes gain the deadly d12 trait' - deadly-strikes already ships {add:[deadly-d10]}. Only fast healing has no lane, so that half stays a mode note (gathering-moss precedent).

mode.name: Golden Body
mode.note: Fast healing 20: you regain 20 HP at the start of each of your turns as long as you have at least 1 HP. Track the healing yourself - the app has no fast-healing lane.

rulings.why: Upheld: fast healing has no field anywhere, and the shipped gathering-moss mode carries fast healing as a note with the words 'the app has no fast-healing lane'. The temp-HP rider is ally-side and was correctly left in the note only.

Upheld: heldSpells (the only stored-spell field) is item-only and rank-keyed, and effectChoices+spellFilter grants innate or focus casting - either would turn a one-use scroll into repeatable casting. needsEngineWork stands.
Upheld: advanced-qi-spells ships the identical shape in core.json - effectChoices with spellFilter {traits:[monk], rank, grantAs:focus}. Only the rank differs.
Upheld: the grip is switched with an Interact action, so it is toggleable by definition; the unconditional reach field would grant 10-ft reach with every weapon at all times.
Upheld: same Advanced Undead Benefits, verified word for word against the AoN mirror. The judge correctly omitted the bound-terrain resistance rather than faking it as a damage type.

Upheld, fix corrected: the text senses UNDEAD only, and lifesense senses living creatures too - an over-grant. deathsense is already shipped in this exact shape by pact-of-the-death-hunter, and senses accepts free-form names with range/acuity.

Upheld: dailyChoicesFor keys each daily choice by dailyChoiceKey(rec.id, def.flag) (dailyChoices.ts:73), so a second record carrying the harbingerRune flag produces a SECOND prompt and a second rune. No field can widen another record's option list.
Upheld: oni-form ships in stances.json as a note-only form record with no reach and no duration field, and the unconditional reach field would apply outside the form.

Upheld: all five bases verified in core.items (blowgun, hatchet, scythe, shortbow, composite-shortbow). traits:[grippli] matches nothing today, which weaponMatches simply skips - harmless, not an over-grant.

Upheld: barbarian-dedication carries the identical entry at situationalBonuses.ts:115 with the same '-1 (penalty)' string, and this feat requires that you CANNOT already Rage, so there is no double-count.
Upheld: strikeDamage only ADDS damage terms and unarmedTraits is unarmed-only - nothing rewrites a wielded weapon's base damage die or adds deadly to it.
Upheld: halfling-luck carries limitedUses {max:1,per:day} in core.json, and forever-among-humanity ships the same day-form usesUpgrade {max:3,per:day}.
Upheld: wildborn-adept ships the identical shape - innateSpells with atWill:true and heightenHalfLevel:true - and spell id light exists in core.spells.

Upheld: phantom-shroud ships the same shape verbatim ({name, die, damageType:void, traits:[agile,finesse,magical,unarmed], group:brawling}) and grantedStrikes accepts both '1d6' and 'd6'. The crit rider was correctly left target-side.
Upheld: modifiers is deliberately empty - a flat +3 AC would stack on the armor the impulse suppresses. No mode for this feat exists in toggle-modes.json.

Upheld, fix corrected: needsEngineWork is wrong. The situational lane takes a spellDamage target (burn-it, dangerous-sorcery, sorcerous-potency) and explicitly supports non-numeric phrase bonuses - situationalBonuses.ts:3049 names 'roll d10s instead of d8s' as its own example of a bonus that never pools.
Upheld: hydra-mutagen and nocturnal-navigator both carry degree-of-success upgrades as phrase bonuses in the situational lane. The Coerce half was correctly left on the other creature's side.

Upheld, fix corrected: same as harming-hands - spellDamage covers restored Hit Points too (sorcerous-potency's when clause says 'deals damage or restores Hit Points'), and phrase bonuses are supported.
Upheld: a one-action self-buff with a stated duration is the mode lane, and the added amount scales per-Strike so it correctly stays a note rather than a static modifier.

Upheld, fix corrected: the judge said no field touches Bulk limits - bulkLimitBonus EXISTS (types.ts:771) and deriveBulk reads it at derive.ts:1976, with beast-of-burden already shipping bulkLimitBonus:4 for the identical wording. This feat says 2.

Upheld: substituteTokens (derive.ts:605-618) supports only @actor.level, ability mods and Speeds, and resolveFormula returns 0 for any surviving @ token - so the archetype-feat-count formula genuinely cannot be written, and a flat number would misstate it.

Upheld: derive.ts:1900 hardcodes 'penalty - 5' when the Strength requirement is met, with no feat hook, so the sheet shows the wrong Speed. The situational lane is the only non-over-granting expression.

Upheld: advancedAlchemy is an {items, addInt, atLevel} budget feeding the alchemist AlchemyPanel and would offer any formula; effectChoices needs options or a spellFilter and there is no item filter. No daily temporary-item lane exists.
Upheld: unarmedTraits is the only trait-adding lane and it is explicitly unarmed-only ('Traits this feat adds to unarmed Strikes', types.ts:781). Nothing adds a trait to a wielded weapon.
Upheld: critSpecWeapons.groups is a declared key (types.ts:320) read by weaponMatches, and polearm, spear and sword are all real CRIT_SPEC groups.

Upheld: the spell exists in core.spells at rank 0 with the composition trait, and dirge-of-doom, allegro, triple-time and loremasters-etude all carry focusSpells:[<own id>] in core.json. This one carries nothing.
Upheld: CompanionMod has no size or reach field, and note-only eidolon entries already ship (airborne-form, vibration-sense). featPickGrants.ts only OFFERS this feat, it does not implement it.
Upheld: no field adds a trait to a wielded weapon and no ikon imbue/immanence state is modelled.

Upheld, fix corrected: needsEngineWork is wrong - the mode lane already carries fast healing as a note. gathering-moss ships exactly this case (fast healing triggered by entering a stance) with modifiers:[] and the note 'Track the healing yourself - the app has no fast-healing lane'.

mode.name: Immortal Bear
mode.note: Fast healing 5 while you are in Ursine Avenger Form. Track the healing yourself - the app has no fast-healing lane.

rulings.why: Upheld: prescient-planner carries no limitedUses in core.json, so the five-per-day allowance this feat adds has no tracker. limitedUses on the feat itself is right - a usesUpgrade would invent a per-day pool on a feat that has none.
Upheld: same bounded five-per-day resource, same reasoning as the investigator record.
Upheld: the initiate benefits exist as classFeatures but build.ts only pushes them inside ownsClass('thaumaturge'), and no data field points a feat at a classFeature.

Upheld: maturityFloor is a real CompanionMod key and battle-hardened-companion already ships the identical nimble entry. MATURITY_RANK (companions.ts:336) puts nimble and savage on the same rung, so the floor can never downgrade a savage pick.
Upheld: mature is the printed rung and advanced-construct-companion already ships maturityFloor:mature for the same wording.
Upheld: deriveBlastStrikes computes blast dice from character level alone and no field expresses a damage-die count.
Upheld: resurgent-maelstrom ships the same target and almost the same bonus string ('the -2 item penalty does not apply') at situationalBonuses.ts:2687.
Upheld: the maturity ladder is the engine's model for this wording and kinds:[animal] covers every companion the beastmaster holds, matching 'each of them'.

Upheld: nimble is the correct floor and it only ever raises (companions.ts:346). The Companions tab does let the player set maturity by hand, but the shipped registry now carries six equivalent upgrade feats, so leaving this one out would be the inconsistency.
Upheld: identical wording and identical reasoning to the druid record.
Upheld: behold-my-creation already ships maturityFloor:nimble for the exact phrase 'becomes an incredible construct companion', one rung above advanced-construct-companion's mature.
Upheld: the text says nimble or savage outright, so nimble is the printed floor.

Upheld: enhanced-psychopomp-familiar and adaptive-mask-familiar both ship the abilityBudget + supersedes pattern in FEAT_COMPANION_GRANTS, and featGrantedCompanions dedupes via supersedes so only one familiar card shows.
Upheld: INVESTED_LIMIT is a bare const 10 in InventoryTab.tsx:119, enforced on the Invest button and the x/10 badge. featFeatGrants.ts only GRANTS this feat, it does not implement it.
Upheld: same maturity ladder, nimble floor precedented by battle-hardened-companion.
Upheld: advanced-reanimated-companion already ships maturityFloor:mature one rung below, so nimble here is consistent.
Upheld: a spend-a-use self-buff with a stated duration is the mode lane; the amount scales with your Tattooed Historian feat count, so a static modifier would be wrong and the note is correct.

Upheld: barbarian-dedication stores the barbarianInstinct choice flag but rageStrikeRider honours subclassId only, so an archetype barbarian gets a flat 2 damage and no instinct ability. No field expresses instinct abilities.
